name: frontend-mastery-skills
description: Master front-end agent skills: scan, audit, build, gate, learn.

scripts.setup: npm i && npx playwright install chromium
scripts.check: npm run check:syntax && npm run check:selftest
scripts.check:syntax: for f in skills/fe-scan/scripts/*.mjs skills/fe-guard/scripts/*.mjs skills/fe-inspect/scripts/*.mjs skills/fe-reference/scripts/*.mjs scripts/*.mjs; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.check:selftest: node skills/fe-scan/scripts/compare.mjs --selftest && node skills/fe-scan/scripts/crawlers.mjs --selftest && node skills/fe-scan/scripts/run-all.mjs https://example.invalid --dry-run
